findings.evidence: `directSumEquivProd_apply_fst`, `_apply_snd`, `_symm_apply_inl`, and `_symm_apply_inr` each have a bare proof `Submodule.directSumEquivProd_… _ _ …`, while `AddSubgroup.directSumEquivProd` is defined via `.toIntSubmodule` and `.toAddEquiv` at lines 73–75.
findings.fix: Add an explicit bridge lemma for how `AddSubgroup.directSumEquivProd` acts (proved with controlled unfolding), then derive all four coordinate simp lemmas from it without relying on wrapper definitional equality.
findings.issue: All four coordinate lemmas at lines 80–99 are proved by directly applying the corresponding `Submodule` theorem, so they work only through definitional equality of `toIntSubmodule`, `toAddEquiv`, and subtype coercions.

summary: The additive equivalence coordinate API relies on undocumented definitional equality across subgroup/submodule wrappers.
